title: introduce-preflight-static-check-stage-and-dep-bloom-updater
author: Ava Martinez
rollback_plan: feature-flag off + revert single squashed commit; release hook supports immediate rollback by disabling preflight in deploy config
description: Motivation: CI feedback cycles are noisy and slow when running full integration matrices for every dependency automation PR. This change adds a lightweight preflight static-check stage and a new 'dep-bloom' updater that groups transitive dependency bumps to reduce CI churn and make release automation more predictable. Changes: 1) preflight: introduce a new lightweight pipeline stage (preflight/static-check) that runs manifest/schema linters, minimal unit linting, and dependency-safety heuristics before triggering heavier integration lanes; 2) dep-bloom-updater: add a tool that forms non-breaking transitive dependency update batches ("bloom"), reducing the number of CI runs and making rollouts safer; 3) small refactor of release hook scripts to call the orchestrator shim (release-orch) which is feature-flagged; 4) docs and quickstart for maintainers and QA. Checklist: - [x] design review with SRE and Release leads; - [x] unit + integration tests for preflight stage runner; - [x] e2e smoke run on release-orch in staging; - [x] Linear tasks linked; - [x] feature flag gated behind infra.flags.preflight_adoption Migration notes: preflight stage is additive and gated. Dep-bloom is opt-in; repo maintainers can enable via .ci/config by toggling dep_bloom: true. Rollout: enable for small set of repositories first (redwood, redwood-sdk-python) then expand. Risk/Notes: intermediate false-positives in static-check may block infra PRs; mitigated by 'allowlist' for known generated files and an override label (ci/preflight-skip) for emergency bypass. Related items: ENG-2144 (ci feedback), ENG-2201 (dep automation roadmap).
commits: feat(preflight): add static manifest linter and lightweight runner
feat(dep-bloom): initial implementation of dependency bloom grouping algorithm
chore(release): replace release-hook.sh with release-orch shim and flag
test(ci): add unit tests for preflight runner and dep-bloom matcher
docs(ci): document opt-in config and troubleshooting guide
review_conversation: Samir Patel: Nice direction. A few questions: how do we guarantee dep-bloom doesn't combine breaking bumps?

Ava Martinez: dep-bloom uses a compatibility probe that checks semver ranges and runs package manager dry-run; it only groups patches/minor bumps that pass the probe. Added tests to cover range logic.
Jordan Li: Preflight run adds ~18s to PR runs in our sampling. Can we parallelize lint shards?
Ava Martinez: Parallelized two lint shards and made static-checks scored so heavy checks are skipped for very small changes. That cut the extra time to ~7s in sample CI runs.
Priya Rao: Approving pending CI pass. Confirmed feature flag gating and rollback plan.
Samir Patel: Approved. Left a nit for docs to include instructions for emergency bypass label.
Ava Martinez: Addressed doc nit and added scripts/maintainers/enable-dep-bloom.sh for safe opt-in. Merging once CI completes.
release_notes: Adds a gated preflight static-check CI stage and an opt-in dependency grouping tool (dep-bloom) to reduce CI churn from dependency updates. Includes a feature-flagged release orchestrator shim and maintainers' docs. No breaking changes.
files_for_maintainers: See .ci/config.yaml and docs/ci/preflight.md for opt-in steps; run scripts/maintainers/enable-dep-bloom.sh to enable per-repo; use ci/preflight-skip label to bypass in emergencies.
notes_after_merge: Enabled the preflight stage for the redwood repo in staging; dep-bloom set to opt-in for SDK repos. Follow-up tasks: expand allowlist, add language-specific probes for go/py/node (ENG-2201).
